name: FINOS AI Governance Framework (AIGF)
description: Agent-configuration checks evidencing FINOS AIGF mitigations. Control IDs are the catalogue's own mitigation IDs (AIR-PREV-nnn / AIR-DET-nnn) from https://github.com/finos/ai-governance-framework at a149dd1eb763c0be4ff8107b698c41230ecfbfc8 (2026-10-07). The agent context schema is policy/frameworks/finos-aigf/v1.0/AGENT-CONTEXT.md.

controlSets.name: AIGF Preventative Mitigations (AIR-PREV)
controlSets.description: Catalogue mitigations of type PREV that are evidenced by agent configuration and registry facts.

controls.name: AIR-PREV-002 Data Filtering From External Knowledge Bases
controls.description: Sensitive data is filtered before external knowledge is ingested into a RAG pipeline. Mitigates: AIR-RC-001 Information Leaked To Hosted Model, AIR-SEC-009 Data Poisoning.

checks.name: RAG ingestion filters sensitive data
checks.description: If the agent uses retrieval-augmented generation (agent.data.rag_enabled is true), sensitive-data filtering must be active on ingestion. Not applicable, and passes, when rag_enabled is false. Undeclared or non-boolean rag_enabled fails.
checks.celExpression: has(agent.data) && type(agent.data) == map && has(agent.data.rag_enabled) && type(agent.data.rag_enabled) == bool && (agent.data.rag_enabled == false || (has(agent.data.ingestion_sensitive_data_filter) && agent.data.ingestion_sensitive_data_filter == true))
checks.remediation: Enable sensitive-data filtering (PII/confidential classification and redaction) on every RAG ingestion path, or declare rag_enabled false.

controls.name: AIR-PREV-003 User/App/Model Firewalling/Filtering
controls.description: Interactions between users, the application and the model are inspected and filtered in both directions. Mitigates: AIR-OP-007 Availability of Foundational Model, AIR-SEC-010 Prompt Injection, AIR-OP-018 Model Overreach / Expanded Use, AIR-OP-020 Reputational Risk.

checks.name: Active prompt injection filter guardrail
checks.description: Enforces real-time input guardrails to detect adversarial prompt injection attacks (agent.guardrails.prompt_injection_filter is true).
checks.remediation: Enable prompt injection detection filter in agent inference pipeline.

checks.name: Model output filtered for leakage and harmful content
checks.description: Model responses are inspected for sensitive-data leakage and policy-violating content before they leave the system (agent.guardrails.output_filter is true).
checks.celExpression: has(agent.guardrails) && type(agent.guardrails) == map && has(agent.guardrails.output_filter) && agent.guardrails.output_filter == true
checks.remediation: Enable output filtering/redaction on the response path (DLP and content policy) before responses reach users or downstream systems.

controls.name: AIR-PREV-008 Quality of Service (QoS) and DDoS Prevention for AI Systems
controls.description: Single or few callers cannot exhaust finite inference capacity. Mitigates: AIR-OP-007 Availability of Foundational Model.

checks.name: Inference request rate limit configured
checks.description: A positive per-minute request limit is enforced on the agent (agent.rate_limits.requests_per_minute is a JSON number > 0).
checks.remediation: Configure a per-caller request rate limit at the gateway or inference proxy and record it in the agent registry.

controls.name: AIR-PREV-010 AI Model Version Pinning
controls.description: The deployed model is inventoried and pinned to a specific, approved version rather than a floating alias. Mitigates: AIR-OP-005 Foundation Model Versioning, AIR-OP-006 Non-Deterministic Behaviour.

checks.name: Model catalog registration and approval
checks.description: Verifies AI agent model is registered and actively approved in the enterprise model inventory (agent.registry.model_registered is true).
checks.celExpression: has(agent.registry) && type(agent.registry) == map && has(agent.registry.model_registered) && agent.registry.model_registered == true
checks.remediation: Register model in the centralized enterprise AI model registry.

checks.name: Model version pinned, not a floating alias
checks.description: agent.registry.model_version is a non-empty string without whitespace that does not end in a 'latest' alias segment (case-insensitive, e.g. '-latest', ':latest', or bare 'latest').
checks.celExpression: has(agent.registry) && type(agent.registry) == map && has(agent.registry.model_version) && type(agent.registry.model_version) == string && agent.registry.model_version.matches('^\\S+$') && !agent.registry.model_version.matches('(?i)(^|[-_.:@/])latest$')
checks.remediation: Pin the model to an explicit dated or digest version and record it in the registry; upgrade only through change control.

controls.name: AIR-PREV-012 Role-Based Access Control for AI Data
controls.description: Callers are authenticated and their access to the agent and its data is governed by roles. Mitigates: AIR-RC-001 Information Leaked To Hosted Model, AIR-SEC-008 Tampering With the Foundational Model, AIR-SEC-009 Data Poisoning.

checks.name: Caller authentication and RBAC enforced
checks.description: Callers must authenticate (agent.access.authentication_required is true) and role-based authorisation is enforced (agent.access.rbac_enforced is true).
checks.celExpression: has(agent.access) && type(agent.access) == map && has(agent.access.authentication_required) && agent.access.authentication_required == true && has(agent.access.rbac_enforced) && agent.access.rbac_enforced == true
checks.remediation: Front the agent with the enterprise IdP and enforce role-based authorisation on the data and actions it exposes.

controls.name: AIR-PREV-014 Encryption of AI Data at Rest
controls.description: Every persistent store the agent writes (vector indexes, conversation history, caches) is encrypted at rest. Mitigates: AIR-SEC-002 Information Leaked to Vector Store, AIR-RC-022 Regulatory Compliance and Oversight.

checks.name: All persistent AI data stores encrypted at rest
checks.description: Every entry of agent.data.persistent_stores has encrypted_at_rest true. An empty list (the agent persists nothing) passes; an absent or non-list field fails.
checks.celExpression: has(agent.data) && type(agent.data) == map && has(agent.data.persistent_stores) && type(agent.data.persistent_stores) == list && agent.data.persistent_stores.all(s, type(s) == map && has(s.encrypted_at_rest) && s.encrypted_at_rest == true)
checks.remediation: Enable encryption at rest (KMS-managed keys) on every vector store, history store and cache the agent uses.

controls.name: AIR-PREV-018 Agent Authority Least Privilege Framework
controls.description: Each agent tool is granted only explicitly enumerated, narrow scopes. Mitigates: AIR-SEC-024 Agent Action Authorization Bypass, AIR-OP-018 Model Overreach / Expanded Use.

checks.name: Tool grants are explicitly scoped, no wildcards
checks.description: Every entry of agent.tools declares a non-empty scopes list of non-empty strings, none ending in '*' (no '*' or prefix wildcards). An empty tools list passes; an absent or non-list field fails.
checks.celExpression: has(agent.tools) && type(agent.tools) == list && agent.tools.all(t, type(t) == map && has(t.scopes) && type(t.scopes) == list && size(t.scopes) > 0 && t.scopes.all(s, type(s) == string && s != '' && !s.endsWith('*')))
checks.remediation: Replace wildcard and unscoped tool grants with enumerated per-tool scopes matched to the agent's designated function.

controls.name: AIR-PREV-020 MCP Server Security Governance
controls.description: The agent connects only to MCP servers on the centrally maintained allow-list. Mitigates: AIR-SEC-026 MCP Server Supply Chain Compromise, AIR-SEC-008 Tampering With the Foundational Model, AIR-RC-001 Information Leaked To Hosted Model.

checks.name: Only allow-listed MCP servers connected
checks.description: Every entry of agent.mcp_servers has allowlisted true. An empty list (no MCP servers) passes; an absent or non-list field fails.
checks.celExpression: has(agent.mcp_servers) && type(agent.mcp_servers) == list && agent.mcp_servers.all(m, type(m) == map && has(m.allowlisted) && m.allowlisted == true)
checks.remediation: Route MCP connections through the central proxy and remove any server not on the security-vetted allow-list.

controls.name: AIR-PREV-023 Agentic System Credential Protection Framework
controls.description: Long-lived credentials are kept out of the agent's execution environment; credentials are injected just in time. Mitigates: AIR-SEC-029 Agent-Mediated Credential Discovery and Harvesting, AIR-SEC-024 Agent Action Authorization Bypass, AIR-SEC-026 MCP Server Supply Chain Compromise.

checks.name: No long-lived credentials exposed to the agent
checks.description: agent.credentials.long_lived_secrets_exposed is boolean false. Absent or non-boolean fails: lack of a finding is not evidence of protection.
checks.remediation: Remove static API keys and secrets from the agent's environment and files; deliver short-lived credentials via workload identity or a secrets broker.

controls.name: AIR-PREV-024 Human-in-the-Loop Action Approval Gate
controls.description: High-impact agent actions are held for explicit human approval. Catalogue doc-status of this mitigation is Draft at the pinned commit. Mitigates: AIR-SEC-024 Agent Action Authorization Bypass, AIR-OP-018 Model Overreach / Expanded Use, AIR-RC-022 Regulatory Compliance and Oversight.

checks.name: High-impact tools gated by human approval
checks.description: Every entry of agent.tools either declares impact 'low' or 'medium', or has requires_human_approval true. Tools with impact 'high' or no impact classification are treated as high (fail-closed). Not applicable, and passes, when every tool is low/medium or the list is empty; an absent or non-list field fails.
checks.celExpression: has(agent.tools) && type(agent.tools) == list && agent.tools.all(t, type(t) == map && (has(t.impact) && t.impact in ['low', 'medium']) || (has(t.requires_human_approval) && t.requires_human_approval == true))
checks.remediation: Classify every tool's impact and route high-impact and unclassified tool calls through a fail-closed human approval gate.

controlSets.name: AIGF Detective Mitigations (AIR-DET)
controlSets.description: Catalogue mitigations of type DET that are evidenced by agent configuration and registry facts.

controls.name: AIR-DET-004 AI System Observability
controls.description: Agent interactions, tool calls and security events are logged to an audit trail. Mitigates: AIR-RC-001, AIR-OP-005, AIR-OP-006, AIR-OP-007, AIR-OP-014, AIR-OP-018, AIR-OP-019, AIR-SEC-024, AIR-SEC-025, AIR-SEC-026, AIR-SEC-027, AIR-OP-028, AIR-SEC-029.

checks.name: Agent interaction audit logging enabled
checks.celExpression: has(agent.observability) && type(agent.observability) == map && has(agent.observability.audit_logging) && agent.observability.audit_logging == true
checks.remediation: Ship prompts, responses, tool calls and policy decisions to the central audit log with retention per policy.

controls.name: AIR-DET-009 AI System Alerting and Denial of Wallet (DoW) / Spend Monitoring
controls.description: Spend is bounded by a budget and overconsumption raises an alert. Mitigates: AIR-OP-007 Availability of Foundational Model.

checks.name: Spend budget and alerting configured
checks.description: agent.cost_controls.budget_limit is a JSON number > 0 and agent.cost_controls.spend_alerting is true.
checks.celExpression: has(agent.cost_controls) && type(agent.cost_controls) == map && has(agent.cost_controls.budget_limit) && type(agent.cost_controls.budget_limit) == double && agent.cost_controls.budget_limit > 0.0 && has(agent.cost_controls.spend_alerting) && agent.cost_controls.spend_alerting == true
checks.remediation: Set a budget for the agent's model usage and configure threshold alerts against it.

controls.name: AIR-DET-021 Agent Decision Audit and Explainability
controls.description: Agent decisions are recorded with explanations in a tamper-evident audit trail. Mitigates: AIR-SEC-024 Agent Action Authorization Bypass, AIR-SEC-025 Tool Chain Manipulation and Injection, AIR-RC-022 Regulatory Compliance and Oversight.

checks.name: Decision explainability and reasoning trace
checks.description: Requires recorded reasoning traces and explainability metadata for compliance auditing (agent.governance.decision_explainability is true).
checks.remediation: Record structured reasoning traces and explainability metadata on tool invocations.

checks.name: Decision audit log is tamper-evident
checks.description: agent.governance.audit_log_tamper_evident is true (cryptographic integrity protection on the decision log).
checks.remediation: Write decision records to an append-only, hash-chained or signed log so tampering is detectable.
